sentences.text: The evidence provided shows a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure in a home-loan agreement, and a table repeats the same charge.
A copied home-loan version instead states a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure.
I could not determine the foreclosure charge for car loans from the evidence provided because the in-force loan documents shown are home-loan documents, not car-loan documents.

missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force loan documents and the provided RBI rule findings for any car-loan foreclosure or pre-payment charge; only home-loan documents were provided.
